title: Fraction charts identify quotient maps on sections
statement: Let $S,T$ be schemes, $h:T\to S$, $\mathcal E$ a quasi-coherent module, $D$ a normalized tautological quotient, $L$ an invertible module, $q:h^*\mathcal E\to L$ an epimorphism, and $F$ a morphism with the specified homogeneous fraction charts. For every open $U\subseteq T$ and section $x\in\Gamma(h^*\mathcal E,U)$, the two quotient sections have equal vanishing: $q_F(x)=0$ if and only if $q(x)=0$.

source.place: Tags 01OA and 01O4, affine fraction-chart calculation and localization by a degree-one generator.

proof.text: On affine base and line-trivializing affine charts, the fraction equations identify the pulled tautological frame with the quotient frame after multiplication by the denominator coefficient. The degree-one equations then identify the images of all generating sections. Restricting to the basic opens where the denominator is invertible and using the chart cover gives equality of vanishing on an arbitrary open; sheaf separatedness gives the displayed equivalence.
